events.matchHint: Quarterly Adventure Days with Chattanooga Public Library: library card holders 18 and under get free zoo admission, story time at 11am and noon, hands-on activities all day. Dates: March 22, June 28, September 20, December 20. Hours 9am-5pm.

Monthly Conservation Awareness Days celebrating SAFE (Saving Animals From Extinction) programs: keeper chats, animal enrichment, info stations, arts and crafts. Dates: September 19, October 24, November 21. Hours 11am-3pm. Included with standard admission.
Asian Lantern Festival: Wildlife Wonderland — seasonal nightly event Nov-Jan, Wed-Sun 5:30-9:30pm, hundreds of illuminated lanterns up to 16 feet tall across nearly 50 scenes. Excludes Christmas Day.
